title: Stamp gates: Total receipt
summary: Replace each negative reading with 0; leave every other reading unchanged. Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence.
descriptionMd:
A damaged approval stamp has been replacing rejected readings with blanks on the dispatch form. Sol is closing the print-room account before the afternoon mail. A single total must replace the pile of working slips.

Replace each negative reading with 0; leave every other reading unchanged.

Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence.

Implement stampGatesTotalReceipt(readings, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: Conditionals. Replace each negative reading with 0; leave every other reading unchanged. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys (earlier units are used while the first two levels establish the foundations).
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with conditionals. What state describes the portion you have already processed?
Replace each negative reading with 0; leave every other reading unchanged. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.

cases.explanation: The derived sequence is [7,0,7,0,12]. Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence. This gives 26.
The derived sequence is [4,4,0,4]. Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence. This gives 12.
The derived sequence is []. Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence. This gives 0.

overview: Variation: Conditionals. Build the sequence once, then report exactly what the inspection card requests.
